t.zh: 到这里为止，证明板只显示一句话证出了没有。这一章看证明本身：它可以写成一个式子，叫<wiki-ref to="proof-term"></wiki-ref>，写法照<wiki-ref to="lean"></wiki-ref>。从这一关起，证明板上的元件都显示自己的证明项。
t.en: Until now the proof board has only shown whether a sentence is proved. This chapter looks at the proof itself: it can be written as an expression, a <wiki-ref to="proof-term"></wiki-ref>, written as in <wiki-ref to="lean"></wiki-ref>. From this level on, every part on the proof board shows its proof term.

t.zh: 每条已知的名字就是它的证明项。A → B 的证明可以看成一个函数：给它 A 的证明，它还你 B 的证明。所以套用就是函数应用，写作 p q。一句话是一个类型，它的证明是这个类型的程序：这叫。
t.en: The name of each given is its proof term. A proof of A → B can be seen as a function: give it a proof of A and it gives back a proof of B. So Apply is function application, written p q. A sentence is a type, and its proof a program of that type: this is the .

briefNote.zh: 证明项须为 p q r。
briefNote.en: Its proof term must be p q r.

hint.zh: p q r 是 (p q) r：先把 p 用在 q 上，得到的再用在 r 上。
hint.en: p q r is (p q) r: first p used on q, then what that gives used on r.

briefNote.en: Its proof term must be q (p r).

hint.zh: 括号里的先算：p r 是一次套用，q 再用在它上面。
hint.en: What is in brackets comes first: p r is one Apply, and q is used on that.
